naam: Been naar achteren laten glijden – met handdoek
pose_en: She stands upright, seen exactly from the side, facing left, in front of a sturdy kitchen counter (on the left of the image) and holds its edge with BOTH hands, arms almost straight. Her feet are side by side; the RIGHT foot stands on a small folded towel on a smooth floor, the left foot flat on the floor with the left knee slightly bent. The arrow is a long straight horizontal arrow starting at the right foot and pointing BACKWARD (to the right of the image) along the floor, showing the right foot sliding backward on the towel.
eind_en: END position: seen from the side, facing left, the right leg has slid far BACKWARD and is straight, the right foot still on the towel on the floor behind her; her trunk leans forward with a straight back from the hips, both hands still hold the counter edge, and the left (standing) knee stays slightly bent.
extra_avatar: Both figures seen exactly from the side, facing left, the counter and the towel under the right foot clearly visible. TOP: feet side by side, upright. BOTTOM: right foot slid at least one long step behind her on the towel, right leg straight, trunk inclined forward, left knee slightly bent.

pose_en: CLOSE-UP framing: show only her body from the waist down to the knees (plus the hands resting beside the hips), seen from the side. She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, head toward the left, legs straight and together, arms relaxed alongside her body. Nothing moves. Draw ONE short curved arrow right next to her buttock, curving from the outer buttock toward the middle of the pelvis, showing the buttocks being squeezed together.
eind_en: She holds this position: lying on her back on the mat, legs straight, arms relaxed beside her, the buttock muscles firmly squeezed together and visibly tensed; the pelvis stays on the mat, nothing else moves.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP framing seen from the side: only the hips, buttocks and upper legs on the mat are shown, head and feet cut off. The buttock muscles are clearly firm and contracted, the thighs pressed together; the lower back and pelvis stay flat on the mat.

pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen exactly from the side, head to the left, arms straight alongside her body with the palms down. Both knees are bent, both feet flat on the mat about hip-width apart. The arrow is a curved arrow starting at the right knee and going UP and toward her chest by a quarter circle, showing the right knee being lifted until the thigh is vertical.
eind_en: END position: still lying on her back, seen from the side, the right thigh points straight UP to the ceiling (hip bent 90 degrees) and the right knee is bent 90 degrees so the right shin is horizontal, parallel to the floor (tabletop position); the left foot stays flat on the mat with the left knee bent; arms remain alongside the body.
extra_avatar: Both figures seen exactly from the side. TOP: both feet flat on the mat. BOTTOM: right thigh exactly vertical and right shin exactly horizontal (a clear right angle at hip and knee), left foot still on the mat. The hip must not bend further than 90 degrees.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen exactly from the side, facing left, on her LEFT leg; the toes of her RIGHT foot lightly touch the floor a little behind her, and both arms hang straight beside her body. The arrow is a curved arrow starting at the right knee and going FORWARD and UP, showing the right knee being driven up to hip height.
eind_en: END position: seen from the side, facing left, she balances on the left leg; the right knee is lifted forward to hip height (thigh horizontal, knee bent, foot under the knee); her LEFT arm is bent 90 degrees and swung FORWARD, her RIGHT arm bent 90 degrees and swung BACKWARD, like a sprinter frozen mid-stride; trunk upright.
extra_avatar: Both figures seen exactly from the side, facing left. TOP: standing tall on the left leg, arms down. BOTTOM: running pose - right thigh horizontal, left arm forward, right arm back, both elbows bent. Opposite arm and leg forward.

pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE (bird's-eye view), head at the top of the image and feet at the bottom, so both legs are fully visible. Both legs are straight and side by side, the toes pointing up to the ceiling, arms straight alongside her body. Her right leg is on the viewer's left. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right ankle pointing sideways OUTWARD (to the viewer's left), showing the straight right leg sliding out to the side over the mat.
eind_en: END position: same view from directly above, the straight right leg has slid out to the side (about 30 to 40 degrees away from the left leg), the toes still pointing to the ceiling; the left leg and the pelvis stay in place.
extra_avatar: She is clearly LYING ON HER BACK on an exercise mat on the floor (horizontal, head on the mat), seen from above at a 45-degree angle from the foot end. TOP: both legs straight together. BOTTOM: the right straight leg has slid out sideways over the mat, legs clearly apart in a V.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the FRONT, feet together on the floor, arms relaxed beside her body. A low exercise step (an aerobic step about 20 cm high) stands on the floor directly to her RIGHT side (on the viewer's left). The arrow is a curved arrow starting at the right foot and going UP and SIDEWAYS onto the step (toward the viewer's left), showing the right foot stepping sideways up onto the step.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front, she stands upright with BOTH feet side by side on top of the step, knees straight, arms beside her body; the floor where she started is now to her left (the viewer's right).
extra_avatar: Both figures seen from the front, the step clearly visible in both. TOP: standing on the floor next to the step. BOTTOM: standing on the step with both feet. She steps sideways, not forward.

naam: Gestrekt been naar voren – met elastiek
pose_en: She stands upright, seen exactly from the side, facing left, her left hand on the back of a chair beside her for support. An elastic band loop is around her RIGHT ankle and runs BACKWARD to a fixed anchor low on a door behind her (on the right of the image), at ankle height. Her straight right leg is slightly behind her, toes just touching the floor, the band lightly taut. The arrow is a curved arrow from the right foot going FORWARD and slightly UP, showing the straight leg kicking forward.
eind_en: END position: seen from the side, facing left, her straight right leg is swung FORWARD so the foot is about 30 cm off the floor in front of her, knee straight; the band is stretched from the ankle back to the anchor behind her; trunk upright, hand still on the chair.
extra_avatar: Both figures seen exactly from the side, band and anchor behind her clearly visible. The right knee stays STRAIGHT in both figures - it is a straight-leg kick, not a knee lift.

naam: Heup buigen tegen je hand – ruglig (isometrisch)
pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen exactly from the side, head to the left. Her left knee is bent with the left foot flat on the mat. Her RIGHT thigh points straight up to the ceiling (hip bent 90 degrees) with the right knee bent and the shin horizontal; the palm of her RIGHT hand presses on the front of the right thigh just above the knee, arm straight. Nothing moves. Draw one short straight arrow at the right knee pointing toward her chest, against her hand, showing the knee pushing into the hand.
eind_en: She holds this position: right thigh vertical, right knee bent, the right hand pressing on the thigh just above the knee while the knee pushes into the hand; nothing moves, the left foot stays flat on the mat.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from the side, the hand clearly on the front of the thigh just above the knee, arm straight, pushing against it.

naam: Bilspier rekken – zittend op een stoel
pose_en: She sits upright on a chair, seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view (turned about 45 degrees to the viewer's left), left foot flat on the floor. Her RIGHT ankle rests on her left thigh just above the knee, so the right shin lies across her lap and the right knee points out to her right side (figure-four position). Her hands rest lightly on the right shin and right knee, back straight. The arrow is a curved arrow at her chest going FORWARD and DOWN, showing the trunk bending forward from the hips.
eind_en: END position: same view, still in the figure-four position on the chair, she leans her trunk FORWARD from the hips with a straight back, chest toward the right shin; her right hand rests on the inside of the right knee pressing it gently down.
extra_avatar: Both figures in the same three-quarter front view, the crossed leg (right ankle on left knee) clearly visible. TOP: sitting tall. BOTTOM: leaning clearly forward with a straight back, not a rounded back.

naam: Knie strekken met heup gebogen – ruglig
pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen exactly from the side, head to the left, left leg straight on the mat. Her RIGHT thigh points straight up to the ceiling and both hands hold behind the right thigh just behind the knee; the right knee is bent 90 degrees so the right shin is horizontal. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right foot going UP by a quarter circle, showing the knee being straightened.
eind_en: END position: same view, the right thigh still vertical and held behind the knee with both hands, but the right knee is now straight so the whole right leg points up to the ceiling, sole of the foot toward the ceiling; left leg stays straight on the mat.
extra_avatar: Both figures seen exactly from the side. In both the right thigh is vertical and held by the hands. TOP: shin horizontal. BOTTOM: shin vertical, whole leg straight up. Only the lower leg moves.

pose_en: She lies on her BACK on a bed or exercise mat, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer, her head on a small pillow, arms beside her body, BOTH legs straight. The arrow is a straight horizontal arrow along the surface at the right heel pointing toward her buttocks, showing the heel sliding so the hip and knee bend.
eind_en: END position: same side view, lying on her back. The right heel has slid over the surface toward her buttock: the right hip and knee are bent, the knee pointing to the ceiling, the right foot flat on the surface near the buttock. The left leg stays straight.
extra_avatar: Seen from the side. TOP: both legs straight. BOTTOM: right hip and knee bent, right foot flat on the surface near the buttock - the heel slides and never lifts.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer. A plain chair stands at her LEFT side (partly hidden behind her) and her left hand rests on its backrest for balance. A short loop of elastic band runs around BOTH ankles; both feet are on the floor next to each other. The arrow is a straight arrow at the right knee pointing UP and slightly forward, showing the right knee being lifted against the band.
eind_en: END position: same side view. The right knee is lifted in front of her until the right thigh is almost horizontal, knee bent about 90 degrees, the loop band stretched tight between the lifted right ankle and the standing left ankle. Torso upright, not leaning back.
extra_avatar: Seen from the side, loop band around both ankles in both figures. TOP: both feet on the floor. BOTTOM: right knee lifted to hip height, band clearly stretched between the two ankles, torso upright.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer, standing ONLY on her RIGHT leg, the right knee slightly bent; her LEFT foot is just off the floor beside the right foot. Her hands are on her hips, back straight. The arrow is a curved arrow starting at her upper back and going FORWARD and DOWN, showing the straight-backed torso tipping forward from the hip.
eind_en: END position: same side view, still standing only on the right leg (knee slightly bent). Her torso, with a long FLAT back, is tipped forward from the hip to about 60 degrees, and her LEFT leg is stretched straight BACK behind her, so torso and left leg form one long line like a seesaw. Head in line with the spine.
extra_avatar: Seen from the side. TOP: upright on the right leg. BOTTOM: flat back tipped far forward, left leg stretched straight back in one line with the torso, standing knee slightly bent. The back is never rounded.

pose_en: She stands seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer, in a SHORT lunge stance: her LEFT foot is one step forward, flat on the floor; her RIGHT foot is one step back, the right knee almost straight. A plain chair stands at her LEFT side (partly hidden behind her) and her left hand rests on its backrest for balance. Her torso is upright. The arrow is a straight horizontal arrow at the front of her RIGHT hip pointing FORWARD, showing the hip being pushed forward.
eind_en: END position: same side view and same foot positions. Her pelvis is pushed clearly FORWARD: the front (left) knee is bent more, the right hip is stretched open so the right thigh slants backward, the right heel may lift. Her torso stays UPRIGHT (no hollow back, no leaning forward).
extra_avatar: Seen from the side. TOP: short lunge stance, hips above the middle. BOTTOM: hips shifted far forward over the front foot, the back (right) thigh slanting backward to show the stretch at the front of the right hip; torso vertical.
